channel.title: Incorporeal mass at the center of the Earth
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Incorporeal mass at the center of the Earth" - First SCP idea, looking for Greenlights

item.title: Re: Incorporeal mass at the center of the Earth
item.content:encoded: I like the suggestion of using neutrinos, as they seem to be the closest real-world equivalent to 'incorporeal energy'. As for the fading intangibility I am considering a concept of 'neutrino diffusion', similar to 'hume diffusion' in SCP-3001 and SCP-4903, wherein the intangibility is slowly being shared between the incorporeal objects and earths inner core. This would lead to a sudden absence of the inner core, causing a much more disastrous collapse than would happen if the inner core were replaced with corpses. This would also solve the debate of whether the re-materializing object would replace the solid matter or the other way round. What do you think?

item.title: Re: Incorporeal mass at the center of the Earth
item.content:encoded:
Honestly made me chuckle at the idea there's a serious issue of incorporeal falling in the SCP universe. Interesting idea at the least, a lot of promise especially if you can figure out the source of fading intangible properties.

Maybe something with neutrinos?

item.title: Incorporeal mass at the center of the Earth
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP format with the containment procedures, description, incident log and a log of several SCP-XXXX instances (Possibly collaborative).

Elevator Pitch: Incorporeality is a a common power of anomalies. In most cases this is accompanied by some form of levitation. But happened to all those people who have accomplished the former, but not the latter?

Central Narrative: The SCP is a gigantic mass of incorporeal objects located at the center of the earth, the majority of which are human corpses. The exact size of this mass is [REDACTED] by it is implied to be truly massive. It soon becomes clear to the reader that this is not one central anomaly but the collective resting place of every person or object that has become incorporeal and fallen into the ground. Various examples will include thaumatology, experimental paratechnology, ghosts and possibly a cameo of that D-Class from SCP-4035. The document ends with a incident report describing a foundation incorporeal object containment unit (like those mentioned in SCP-2996 and SCP-4444) accidently becoming incorporeal and falling into the mass, causing part of it to become corporal before the unit is destroyed, causing part of the earths core to collapse in on itself, creating a minor earthquake. A notice from a foundation scientist reveals that the mass as a whole has been losing incorporeality overtime, with the eventual mass re-solidification of the anomaly leading to disastrous results.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Taking a semi-used joke to its logical conclusion.

Additional Notes: I am not sure of a reasonable explanation of the masses re-solidification. Is there an established measure of incorporeal energy that the anomaly can be said to be 'shedding'?
